blocks.zh: Section 3 & 4: PQS Elements & Continual Improvement｜品質系統四大要素與持續改善
blocks.en: Section 3 & 4: PQS Elements & Continual Improvement

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 ICH Q10 四大 PQS 要素（PQS Elements）的定義與各自在生命週期中的作用——這是 Q10 對 GMP 最核心的貢獻
blocks.en: Master the definitions of the four ICH Q10 PQS Elements and the role each plays across the lifecycle. This is Q10's most central contribution to GMP.

blocks.zh: 清楚區分 Correction（即時矯正）、Corrective Action（矯正措施）、Preventive Action（預防措施）三個概念，避免 CAPA 系統最常見的混淆
blocks.en: Clearly distinguish Correction, Corrective Action and Preventive Action, avoiding the most common confusion in CAPA systems.

blocks.zh: 理解 Change Management 的法規雙軌：Design Space 內的變更 vs. 需通報法規機關的批准後變更，以及 Q10 如何管理兩者
blocks.en: Understand the dual regulatory track of Change Management: changes within the Design Space vs. post-approval changes that must be notified to the regulator, and how Q10 manages both.

blocks.zh: 認識 Management Review（管理審查）與 APR/PQR 的關係——CDMO 日常實務中最直接的 Q10 體現
blocks.en: Understand the relationship between Management Review and the APR/PQR, the most direct day-to-day expression of Q10 in CDMO practice.

blocks.zh: 理解 Section 4「持續改善 PQS」的機制：PQS 本身也需要被監控、審查和改善，形成系統層面的 PDCA 閉環
blocks.en: Understand the mechanism of Section 4, "Continual Improvement of the PQS": the PQS itself must also be monitored, reviewed and improved, forming a PDCA closed loop at the system level.

blocks.zh: Section 3 Overview｜持續改善製程績效與產品品質——概述
blocks.en: Section 3 Overview: Continual Improvement of Process Performance and Product Quality

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Q10 的「額外貢獻」是什麼？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Is Q10's "Additional Contribution"?

blocks.zh: Section 3 開宗明義說：這一節描述的是「augment regional requirements（補充地區性 GMP 要求）」的內容，不是重複 GMP。換言之，若你只遵守 GMP，你已有某些這些要素的雛形；Q10 要求你把它們系統化、結構化、並貫穿整個產品生命週期。
blocks.en: Section 3 opens by saying that it describes content that "augments regional requirements" (supplements regional GMP requirements); it does not repeat GMP. In other words, if you only comply with GMP, you already have the beginnings of some of these elements. Q10 requires you to make them systematic and structured, and to apply them throughout the product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 四大要素的關係是：PPQMS（監測）→ CAPA（應對）→ Change Management（改變）→ Management Review（總覽），形成一個閉環的持續改善機制。
blocks.en: The relationship among the four elements is: PPQMS (monitor) → CAPA (respond) → Change Management (change) → Management Review (overview), forming a closed-loop mechanism for continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 3.1 Lifecycle Stage Goals｜各生命週期階段目標
blocks.en: 3.1 Lifecycle Stage Goals

blocks.zh: 核心概念：生命週期的四個階段
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Lifecycle Stages

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Development（藥品開發）：產品和製程的設計階段。Q10 與 Q8 銜接——Q8 提供具體的開發方法論（QbD、Design Space），Q10 將這個階段納入整體 PQS 框架。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Development: the design stage of the product and process. Q10 links with Q8: Q8 provides the specific development methodology (QbD, Design Space), and Q10 brings this stage into the overall PQS framework.

blocks.zh: Technology Transfer（技術轉移）：知識從開發端傳遞到製造端，或在製造廠之間傳遞。注意：技轉的成功與否，直接影響後續 Process Validation 和商業化品質。
blocks.en: Technology Transfer: knowledge is transferred from development to manufacturing, or between manufacturing sites. Note that the success of technology transfer directly affects subsequent process validation and commercial quality.

blocks.zh: Commercial Manufacturing（商業製造）：五個關鍵詞——product realisation（實現）、state of control（管控狀態）、continual improvement（持續改善）、improvement opportunities identified（識別改善機會）、body of knowledge expanded（知識體系擴展）。這五點是商業製造階段 PQS 的核心任務。
blocks.en: Commercial Manufacturing: five key phrases: product realisation, state of control, continual improvement, improvement opportunities identified, and body of knowledge expanded. These five points are the core tasks of the PQS at the commercial manufacturing stage.

blocks.zh: Product Discontinuation（產品停產）：常被忽視的階段。Q10 要求必須有預先定義的停產方法（pre-defined approach），涵蓋文件/樣本留存、持續客訴追蹤和穩定性評估。
blocks.en: Product Discontinuation: an often-neglected stage. Q10 requires a pre-defined approach to discontinuation, covering retention of documentation and samples, continued complaint handling, and stability evaluation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 生命週期如同建築的四個階段
blocks.en: Analogy: The Lifecycle as Four Stages of a Building

blocks.zh: 開發 = 建築師繪製設計圖並做結構測試（Q8 確保設計穩健）
blocks.en: Development = the architect draws the plans and runs structural tests (Q8 ensures the design is robust)

blocks.zh: 技術轉移 = 施工隊接收設計圖並進行試蓋（確保設計意圖能被實現）
blocks.en: Technology transfer = the construction crew receives the plans and builds a trial section (ensuring the design intent can be realised)

blocks.zh: 商業製造 = 大樓投入使用，需要持續維護、監控電力/水管/電梯狀態（state of control），並持續尋找優化空間
blocks.en: Commercial manufacturing = the building is in use and needs ongoing maintenance and monitoring of power, plumbing and elevators (state of control), while continually looking for ways to optimize

blocks.zh: 停產 = 大樓拆除前的資料存檔、住戶安置、後續追蹤（確保沒有遺留問題影響居民安全）
blocks.en: Discontinuation = before demolition, archive the records, relocate the residents and follow up afterwards (ensuring no leftover problems affect residents' safety)

blocks.zh: 停產不是「結束」，是「有序收尾」——市場上仍有存貨，患者仍在使用，品質責任未消失。
blocks.en: Discontinuation is not "the end"; it is an "orderly wind-down". Stock is still on the market, patients are still using the product, and the quality responsibility has not gone away.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：技術轉移的 PQS 意涵
blocks.en: Key Point: PQS Implications of Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: Q10 強調技術轉移傳遞的是「knowledge（知識）」，不只是 SOP。傳統技轉只給製程參數表；Q10 精神的技轉還要傳遞：
blocks.en: Q10 emphasizes that technology transfer conveys "knowledge", not just SOPs. A traditional transfer hands over only a table of process parameters; a transfer in the spirit of Q10 also conveys:

blocks.zh: 為什麼選這個參數範圍（背後的科學理解）
blocks.en: Why this parameter range was chosen (the scientific understanding behind it)

blocks.zh: 關鍵屬性（CQA）與製程參數（CPP）的關係
blocks.en: The relationship between critical quality attributes (CQAs) and process parameters (CPPs)

blocks.zh: 已知的製程風險和應對策略
blocks.en: Known process risks and the strategies to address them

blocks.zh: 先前的失敗案例和學習（lessons learned）
blocks.en: Previous failures and lessons learned

blocks.zh: 這些知識若沒有系統性傳遞，後繼製造廠只能「照本宣科」而缺乏真正理解，一旦製程出現偏差將難以排查根本原因。
blocks.en: If this knowledge is not transferred systematically, the receiving site can only follow the instructions by rote without real understanding, and will struggle to find the root cause when the process deviates.

blocks.zh: 3.2.1 Process Performance and Product Quality Monitoring System (PPQMS)｜製程績效與產品品質監測系統
blocks.en: 3.2.1 Process Performance and Product Quality Monitoring System (PPQMS)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：PPQMS 是製程的「健康監控儀器」
blocks.en: Analogy: The PPQMS Is the Process's "Health Monitor"

blocks.zh: 想像一個病人戴著連續血壓計和血糖監測器。每隔幾分鐘測一次數值，數值在正常範圍內（state of control）就繼續；若開始偏高（趨勢警報），醫生介入調整（feedforward），還沒病發但已預先行動；若數值突然異常（out of control），立即告警啟動 CAPA。
blocks.en: Imagine a patient wearing a continuous blood pressure monitor and a glucose monitor. Values are measured every few minutes. While they stay within the normal range (state of control), things carry on; if they start to drift high (trend alert), the doctor steps in to adjust (feedforward), acting before illness sets in; if a value suddenly goes abnormal (out of control), an alarm sounds immediately and CAPA is triggered.

blocks.zh: PPQMS 對製程就是這樣的角色：
blocks.en: The PPQMS plays exactly this role for the process:

blocks.zh: 血壓/血糖 = CQA 和 CPP（關鍵品質屬性和製程參數）
blocks.en: Blood pressure/glucose = CQAs and CPPs (critical quality attributes and process parameters)

blocks.zh: 正常範圍 = state of control（管控狀態）
blocks.en: Normal range = state of control

blocks.zh: 趨勢預警 = feedforward（前饋控制）
blocks.en: Trend alert = feedforward

blocks.zh: 突發異常 = trigger for CAPA（觸發矯正預防行動）
blocks.en: Sudden abnormality = trigger for CAPA (corrective and preventive action)

blocks.zh: 長期健康報告 = Management Review（管理審查）
blocks.en: Long-term health report = Management Review

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Control Strategy（控制策略）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Control Strategy

blocks.zh: Q10 Glossary 定義：「A planned set of controls, derived from current product and process understanding, that assures process performance and product quality.」
blocks.en: Q10 Glossary definition: "A planned set of controls, derived from current product and process understanding, that assures process performance and product quality."

blocks.zh: 控制策略的組成要素（a 項）：
blocks.en: Components of a control strategy (item a):

blocks.zh: 原料藥和製劑原料與組分的參數和屬性
blocks.en: Parameters and attributes related to drug substance and drug product materials and components

blocks.zh: 設施和設備操作條件
blocks.en: Facility and equipment operating conditions

blocks.zh: 製程中控制（IPC, In-Process Controls）
blocks.en: In-process controls (IPC)

blocks.zh: 成品規格
blocks.en: Finished product specifications

blocks.zh: 各項監測的方法和頻率
blocks.en: The associated methods and frequency of monitoring

blocks.zh: 關鍵：控制策略必須「facilitate timely feedback/feedforward」——即時回饋和前饋，不是事後補救，而是主動預測和管理。
blocks.en: Key point: the control strategy must "facilitate timely feedback/feedforward". This means real-time feedback and feedforward, not after-the-fact remediation, but proactive prediction and management.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：(f) 項的法規戰略意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Regulatory Strategic Significance of Item (f)

blocks.zh: PPQMS 的 (f) 項說：監測系統產生的知識可以「enrich the design space（豐富設計空間），並支持創新的製程確效方法」。
blocks.en: Item (f) of the PPQMS says that the knowledge produced by the monitoring system can "enrich the design space" and support innovative approaches to process validation.

blocks.zh: 這意味著商業製造階段積累的真實批次數據，可以用來：
blocks.en: This means the real batch data accumulated during commercial manufacturing can be used to:

blocks.zh: 擴大或調整原有的 Design Space（需要法規申請）
blocks.en: Expand or adjust the original Design Space (a regulatory filing is required)

blocks.zh: 支持 Continued Process Verification（持續製程查驗）的數據包
blocks.en: Support the data package for Continued Process Verification

blocks.zh: 為 Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) 提供歷史支撐
blocks.en: Provide historical support for Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT)

blocks.zh: 這是 Q10 PPQMS 與 FDA 製程確效 Stage 3（Continued Process Verification）的直接連接點。
blocks.en: This is the direct link between the Q10 PPQMS and Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification) of the FDA process validation guidance.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常同時生產數十個客戶的產品。PPQMS 的挑戰在於：如何對不同複雜程度的產品設計比例適當的監測系統？
blocks.en: A CDMO typically manufactures products for dozens of clients at the same time. The challenge for the PPQMS is how to design monitoring systems proportionate to the complexity of different products.

blocks.zh: 高風險產品（如凍乾注射劑）：每批詳細 CPP 趨勢分析、SPC 管制圖、定期 Cpk 計算
blocks.en: High-risk products (e.g., lyophilized injectables): detailed CPP trend analysis for every batch, SPC control charts, periodic Cpk calculation

blocks.zh: 中風險產品（如口服固體製劑）：關鍵步驟 IPC 趨勢 + 每季批次回顧
blocks.en: Medium-risk products (e.g., oral solid dosage forms): IPC trending at critical steps + quarterly batch review

blocks.zh: 低風險產品：年度統計分析即可
blocks.en: Low-risk products: annual statistical analysis is sufficient

blocks.zh: 比例原則（proportionate approach）是 Q10 的精神——並非所有產品都要同等深度監測，用 QRM 決定監測強度。
blocks.en: The proportionate approach is the spirit of Q10: not every product needs the same depth of monitoring, and QRM is used to decide the monitoring intensity.

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) System｜矯正措施與預防措施系統
blocks.en: 3.2.2 Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) System

blocks.zh: CAPA 流程圖 CAPA Flow
blocks.en: CAPA Flow

blocks.zh:
偏差/事件/趨勢
  Deviation / Event / Trend
         |
         v
  即時矯正 (Correction)
  ── 控制本次影響，保護患者安全 ──
         |
         v
  根本原因分析 (Root Cause Analysis)
  ── 使用 5 Why、Fishbone、FMEA 等工具 ──
  ── 調查深度與風險等級相稱（ICH Q9）──
         |
         v
  制定 CA / PA 方案
  ── CA: 防止再次發生（針對已知原因）──
  ── PA: 防止類似事件初次發生（風險預測）──
         |
         v
  實施 CA / PA
  ── SOP 修訂 / 設備改善 / 培訓 / 製程調整 ──
         |
         v
  有效性驗證 (Effectiveness Check)
  ── 設定可量化的指標，驗證行動確實有效 ──
         |
         v
  關閉 CAPA
  ── 歸檔，知識進入知識管理系統 ──
blocks.en:
Deviation / Event / Trend
         |
         v
  Correction
  -- Contain the impact of this event and protect patient safety --
         |
         v
  Root Cause Analysis
  -- Use tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA --
  -- Depth of investigation commensurate with the risk level (ICH Q9) --
         |
         v
  Develop CA / PA plan
  -- CA: prevent recurrence (addresses a known cause) --
  -- PA: prevent first occurrence of similar events (risk prediction) --
         |
         v
  Implement CA / PA
  -- SOP revision / equipment improvement / training / process adjustment --
         |
         v
  Effectiveness Check
  -- Set measurable indicators to verify the actions really work --
         |
         v
  Close CAPA
  -- Archive; knowledge enters the knowledge management system --

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CAPA 最常見的缺失（稽核發現）
blocks.en: Key Point: The Most Common CAPA Deficiencies (Audit Findings)

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析停於表象：「操作員疏忽」不是根本原因，為什麼系統允許疏忽發生才是。
blocks.en: Root cause analysis stops at the surface: "operator error" is not a root cause; the real question is why the system allowed the error to happen.

blocks.zh: CA 與 PA 混用或缺失 PA：很多公司只做 CA（防止再發），忽略用趨勢數據主動識別類似風險並做 PA。
blocks.en: CA and PA confused, or PA missing: many companies only do CA (preventing recurrence) and neglect to use trend data to proactively identify similar risks and take PA.

blocks.zh: 有效性驗證（Effectiveness Check）未執行：Q10 明確要求「effectiveness of the actions should be evaluated」——沒有驗證等同 CAPA 未關閉。
blocks.en: Effectiveness check not performed: Q10 explicitly requires that "effectiveness of the actions should be evaluated"; without verification the CAPA is effectively not closed.

blocks.zh: CAPA 觸發條件太窄：Q10 的觸發清單包含 complaints、rejections、non-conformances、recalls、deviations、audits、inspections 以及趨勢——趨勢觸發 CAPA（proactive CAPA）是大多數公司的弱點。
blocks.en: CAPA triggers too narrow: the Q10 list of triggers includes complaints, rejections, non-conformances, recalls, deviations, audits, inspections and trends; having trends trigger CAPA (proactive CAPA) is a weakness of most companies.

blocks.zh: PPQMS → CAPA → Change Mgmt 的互動關係
blocks.en: How PPQMS, CAPA and Change Management Interact

blocks.zh: 三個系統是緊密互聯的，不能孤立運作：
blocks.en: The three systems are tightly interconnected and cannot operate in isolation:

blocks.zh: PPQMS 發現製程偏移趨勢 → 觸發 CAPA 調查
blocks.en: The PPQMS detects a process drift trend → triggers a CAPA investigation

blocks.zh: CAPA 的根本原因導致製程需要修改 → 觸發 Change Management
blocks.en: The root cause found by CAPA means the process needs to be modified → triggers Change Management

blocks.zh: 所有三個系統的結果 → 彙整至 Management Review
blocks.en: The results of all three systems → are consolidated into Management Review

blocks.zh: Management Review 的決策 → 反饋指導三個系統的優先序
blocks.en: Management Review decisions → feed back to guide the prioritization of the three systems

blocks.zh: 這個循環正是 Q10 的 PDCA（Plan-Do-Check-Act）在品質管理系統層面的具體體現。
blocks.en: This cycle is the concrete embodiment of Q10's PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) at the level of the quality management system.

blocks.zh: 深度解析：Correction vs. Corrective Action vs. Preventive Action
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis: Correction vs. Corrective Action vs. Preventive Action

blocks.zh: 這是製藥界最常混淆的三個概念，明確區分是 CAPA 系統的基礎：
blocks.en: These are the three concepts most often confused in the pharmaceutical industry, and distinguishing them clearly is the foundation of a CAPA system:

blocks.zh: ISO 9000:2005 定義備注：「Corrective action is taken to prevent recurrence whereas preventive action is taken to prevent occurrence.」這一句話是考試和稽核中最常被引用的區分依據。
blocks.en: ISO 9000:2005 definition note: "Corrective action is taken to prevent recurrence whereas preventive action is taken to prevent occurrence." This sentence is the distinction most often cited in exams and audits.

blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Change Management System｜變更管理系統
blocks.en: 3.2.3 Change Management System

blocks.zh: 變更管理流程 Change Management Process
blocks.en: Change Management Process

blocks.zh:
提案 Change Proposal
  ── 來源：PPQMS 趨勢 / CAPA 結果 / 業務需求 / 創新 ──
         |
         v
  風險評估 Risk Assessment (QRM)
  ── 評估對產品品質、病人安全的潛在影響 ──
  ── 確定法規申報類型（若需要）──
         |
         v
  跨功能審查 Cross-Functional Review
  ── Dev / Mfg / QA / RA / Medical（視需要）──
  ── 設定前瞻性評估標準（Prospective Criteria）──
         |
         v
  核准 Approval
  ── 內部品質授權；外部法規批准（若適用）──
         |
         v
  實施 Implementation
         |
         v
  實施後驗證 Post-Implementation Verification
  ── 確認目標已達成；確認無非預期品質影響 ──
         |
         v
  關閉 Close-out → 回饋知識管理系統
blocks.en:
Change Proposal
  -- Source: PPQMS trends / CAPA outcomes / business needs / innovation --
         |
         v
  Risk Assessment (QRM)
  -- Assess potential impact on product quality and patient safety --
  -- Determine the type of regulatory filing (if required) --
         |
         v
  Cross-Functional Review
  -- Dev / Mfg / QA / RA / Medical (as needed) --
  -- Set prospective evaluation criteria --
         |
         v
  Approval
  -- Internal quality authorization; external regulatory approval (if applicable) --
         |
         v
  Implementation
         |
         v
  Post-Implementation Verification
  -- Confirm objectives were achieved; confirm no unintended quality impact --
         |
         v
  Close-out → feed back to the knowledge management system

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「Prospective Evaluation Criteria」的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of "Prospective Evaluation Criteria"

blocks.zh: (c) 項要求在實施前就設定「前瞻性評估標準」。這意味著：
blocks.en: Item (c) requires that "prospective evaluation criteria" be set before implementation. This means:

blocks.zh: 在變更實施前，就要預先定義「我如何知道這個變更成功了？」
blocks.en: Before the change is implemented, define in advance: "How will I know this change succeeded?"

blocks.zh: 避免事後用「確認偏誤（confirmation bias）」解讀結果
blocks.en: Avoid interpreting the results after the fact through confirmation bias

blocks.zh: 常見指標：規格測試通過率、製程能力指數（Cpk）、溶出曲線相似度等
blocks.en: Common indicators: specification test pass rate, process capability index (Cpk), dissolution profile similarity, etc.

blocks.zh: 這個要求與 FDA 製程確效指引（2011）中的 Stage 2 Protocol 精神一致——驗收標準要事先設定，不能看了數據再訂。
blocks.en: This requirement is consistent with the spirit of the Stage 2 protocol in the FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011): acceptance criteria must be set in advance, not after looking at the data.

blocks.zh: CDMO 面臨的特殊挑戰：同一個變更（如設備更換）可能同時影響多個客戶的產品，每個客戶對應不同地區的法規要求。
blocks.en: A special challenge for CDMOs: the same change (e.g., an equipment replacement) may affect the products of several clients at once, each subject to different regional regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 共用設備更換：需同時評估所有使用該設備的產品，對每個產品分別做風險評估，向各自法規機關按要求申報
blocks.en: Replacement of shared equipment: all products that use the equipment must be assessed together, with a separate risk assessment for each product and filings made to each regulator as required

blocks.zh: 廠址變更：涉及 Site Transfer，通常是 FDA Major Supplement + EMA Type II variation，時間和費用都是重大成本
blocks.en: Site change: involves a site transfer, usually an FDA Major Supplement + EMA Type II variation, with significant time and cost

blocks.zh: Design Space 帶來的效率：有 Design Space 的客戶產品，在 Design Space 內的設備參數調整不需通知法規，節省大量時間和費用——這是 CDMO 協助客戶建立 Design Space 的長期回報
blocks.en: Efficiency from a Design Space: for client products with a Design Space, equipment parameter adjustments within the Design Space do not require regulatory notification, saving considerable time and cost. This is the long-term payoff for a CDMO that helps clients establish a Design Space.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：變更管理的法規「雙軌」
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Regulatory "Dual Track" of Change Management

blocks.zh: Q10 Change Management 處理兩種不同性質的變更，法規後果截然不同：
blocks.en: Q10 Change Management handles two types of change with very different regulatory consequences:

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：Q10 特別指出，即使是 Design Space 內的變更（不需法規申報），仍必須通過公司的 Change Management 系統評估。法規透明度 ≠ 可以繞過內部品質管控。
blocks.en: Key insight: Q10 specifically points out that even changes within the Design Space (which require no regulatory filing) must still be evaluated through the company's Change Management system. Regulatory transparency does not mean internal quality controls can be bypassed.

blocks.zh: 3.2.4 Management Review of Process Performance and Product Quality｜製程績效與產品品質的管理審查
blocks.en: 3.2.4 Management Review of Process Performance and Product Quality

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Management Review 是四大要素的「整合總結」
blocks.en: Core Concept: Management Review Is the "Integrated Summary" of the Four Elements

blocks.zh: Management Review 在結構上是前三個要素（PPQMS、CAPA、Change Management）的資訊匯集點：
blocks.en: Structurally, Management Review is the point where information from the first three elements (PPQMS, CAPA, Change Management) comes together:

blocks.zh: PPQMS 的監測結論 → 進入 Management Review 的 (a)(2)(ii)
blocks.en: PPQMS monitoring conclusions → feed into Management Review item (a)(2)(ii)

blocks.zh: CAPA 的有效性評估 → 進入 Management Review 的 (a)(2)(iii)
blocks.en: CAPA effectiveness evaluation → feeds into Management Review item (a)(2)(iii)

blocks.zh: Change Management 的結果 → 進入 Management Review 的 (a)(2)(iii)
blocks.en: Change Management outcomes → feed into Management Review item (a)(2)(iii)

blocks.zh: 法規檢查發現 + 稽核結果 → 進入 Management Review 的 (a)(1)
blocks.en: Regulatory inspection findings + audit results → feed into Management Review item (a)(1)

blocks.zh: Q10 強調「timely and effective communication and escalation process」——管理審查不是年度一次性形式，而是一個持續運行的升級機制。
blocks.en: Q10 emphasizes a "timely and effective communication and escalation process". Management review is not a one-off annual formality but a continuously operating escalation mechanism.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：APR/PQR 就是 Management Review 的具體落地
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: The APR/PQR Is Where Management Review Lands in Practice

blocks.zh: Annual Product Review (APR) / Product Quality Review (PQR)——這是全球 GMP 要求的年度產品品質報告，也是 Q10 Management Review（3.2.4）+ PQS Management Review（4.1）在實務中最直接的體現。
blocks.en: The Annual Product Review (APR) / Product Quality Review (PQR) is the annual product quality report required by GMP worldwide, and it is the most direct practical expression of Q10 Management Review (3.2.4) + PQS Management Review (4.1).

blocks.zh: 一份完整的 APR/PQR 應涵蓋（對應 Q10 審查內容）：
blocks.en: A complete APR/PQR should cover the following (mapped to the Q10 review content):

blocks.zh: 批次合格率統計（← PPQMS 結論）
blocks.en: Batch conformance statistics (← PPQMS conclusions)

blocks.zh: OOS/偏差趨勢分析（← PPQMS + CAPA）
blocks.en: OOS/deviation trend analysis (← PPQMS + CAPA)

blocks.zh: CAPA 完成狀態與有效性（← CAPA 系統）
blocks.en: CAPA completion status and effectiveness (← CAPA system)

blocks.zh: 年度變更清單與影響評估（← Change Management）
blocks.en: List of changes for the year and impact assessments (← Change Management)

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據趨勢（← PPQMS）
blocks.en: Stability data trends (← PPQMS)

blocks.zh: 客訴和召回數據（← 外部回饋）
blocks.en: Complaint and recall data (← external feedback)

blocks.zh: 法規檢查發現和承諾事項狀態（← 3.2.4(a)(1)）
blocks.en: Regulatory inspection findings and status of commitments (← 3.2.4(a)(1))

blocks.zh: 供應商品質績效（← PPQMS 擴展）
blocks.en: Supplier quality performance (← PPQMS extension)

blocks.zh: 下一年度改善行動計畫（← 3.2.4(b)）
blocks.en: Improvement action plan for the next year (← 3.2.4(b))

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，高品質的 APR/PQR 是向客戶展示品質管理能力的重要界面，也是客戶自身向法規機關展示製造受控的依據。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, a high-quality APR/PQR is an important interface for demonstrating quality management capability to clients, and also the basis on which clients show regulators that manufacturing is under control.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「各層級管理審查」的設計
blocks.en: Key Point: Designing "Management Review at Various Levels"

blocks.zh: Q10 允許 Management Review 是「a series of reviews at various levels」——大公司通常設計多層次審查：
blocks.en: Q10 allows Management Review to be "a series of reviews at various levels". Large companies usually design a multi-level review:

blocks.zh: 操作層（每批/每週）：班組長審查批次記錄、IPC 數據
blocks.en: Operational level (per batch/weekly): shift supervisors review batch records and IPC data

blocks.zh: 部門層（每月）：QA 月報、偏差/CAPA 狀態
blocks.en: Department level (monthly): QA monthly report, deviation/CAPA status

blocks.zh: 廠區層（每季）：產品品質趨勢、重大事件回顧
blocks.en: Site level (quarterly): product quality trends, review of major events

blocks.zh: 公司層（每年）：APR/PQR 彙整、高層管理決策（資源配置、策略調整）
blocks.en: Company level (annually): APR/PQR consolidation, senior management decisions (resource allocation, strategic adjustments)

blocks.zh: 關鍵：每一層的審查結果，必須有「escalation pathway」——確保重要品質問題能及時上達決策層，這正是 Q10 Section 4 的核心精神。
blocks.en: Key: the results of each level of review must have an "escalation pathway" to ensure that important quality issues reach decision-makers in time. This is precisely the core spirit of Q10 Section 4.

blocks.zh: Section 4: Continual Improvement of the PQS｜品質系統本身的持續改善
blocks.en: Section 4: Continual Improvement of the PQS

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Section 3 vs. Section 4 的區別
blocks.en: Core Concept: Section 3 vs. Section 4

blocks.zh: 兩個 Section 都涉及「Management Review」，但層次不同：
blocks.en: Both Sections involve "Management Review", but at different levels:

blocks.zh: Section 3.2.4：審查個別「產品」的製程績效和品質狀態（product-level review）——這批產品的 PPQMS 結果如何、CAPA 有效嗎、變更有沒有達到預期？
blocks.en: Section 3.2.4: reviews the process performance and quality status of individual "products" (product-level review): how are the PPQMS results for this product, is CAPA effective, did the changes achieve what was expected?

blocks.zh: Section 4.1：審查整個「PQS 系統」本身的健全性（system-level review）——CAPA 系統運作是否有效率？Change Management 流程是否能處理各種複雜度的變更？我們的整體品質政策是否仍然適當？
blocks.en: Section 4.1: reviews the soundness of the whole "PQS" itself (system-level review): is the CAPA system operating efficiently? Can the Change Management process handle changes of varying complexity? Is our overall quality policy still appropriate?

blocks.zh: 這是「改善產品品質」與「改善品質系統本身」的差異——Section 4 是 PQS 的 meta-layer（元層次）。
blocks.en: This is the difference between "improving product quality" and "improving the quality system itself": Section 4 is the meta-layer of the PQS.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：PQS 的「年度體檢」
blocks.en: Analogy: The PQS "Annual Check-up"

blocks.zh: Section 3.2.4 = 監測每個病人的血壓/血糖（產品層面的健康狀態）
blocks.en: Section 3.2.4 = monitoring each patient's blood pressure/glucose (the health status at product level)

blocks.zh: Section 4.1 = 評估整個醫院的醫療系統是否運作良好（系統層面）：
blocks.en: Section 4.1 = assessing whether the whole hospital's medical system is working well (system level):

blocks.zh: 醫生（品質人員）的人力夠嗎？
blocks.en: Are there enough doctors (quality staff)?

blocks.zh: 診斷流程（調查和 CAPA）是否有效率？
blocks.en: Is the diagnostic process (investigations and CAPA) efficient?

blocks.zh: 醫院設備（監測工具）是否跟上最新技術？
blocks.en: Is the hospital equipment (monitoring tools) keeping up with the latest technology?

blocks.zh: 有沒有新的法規（新藥法/新 GMP 指引）要求醫院改變流程？
blocks.en: Are there new regulations (new drug laws/new GMP guidelines) that require the hospital to change its processes?

blocks.zh: 把醫院換成製藥廠，問題完全對應——Section 4 就是對「品質管理系統這個醫院」做年度體檢。
blocks.en: Replace the hospital with a pharmaceutical plant and the questions map exactly. Section 4 is the annual check-up of the "hospital" that is the quality management system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：4.2 外部因素監控的現實意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Practical Meaning of 4.2 Monitoring of External Factors

blocks.zh: Q10 要求主動監控「外部因素」，對製藥公司的具體意涵：
blocks.en: Q10 requires proactive monitoring of "external factors". For pharmaceutical companies this means specifically:

blocks.zh: (a) Emerging regulations：FDA 發布新的 Process Validation Guidance（如 2011 年版）、EMA 新增 GMP Annex 修訂——品質系統必須響應更新
blocks.en: (a) Emerging regulations: FDA issues a new Process Validation Guidance (such as the 2011 version), or the EMA revises a GMP Annex; the quality system must respond to the update

blocks.zh: (b) Innovations：ICH Q12（Life Cycle Management）通過後，需評估 Change Management 系統是否能利用 PAC（Post-Approval Change Management Protocol）帶來的新彈性
blocks.en: (b) Innovations: once ICH Q12 (Life Cycle Management) is adopted, evaluate whether the Change Management system can use the new flexibility offered by the PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol)

blocks.zh: (c) Business environment changes：公司被收購、新市場進入、產品組合擴大——PQS 的資源配置和流程設計需要跟著調整
blocks.en: (c) Business environment changes: the company is acquired, enters new markets, or expands its product portfolio; the PQS resource allocation and process design must be adjusted accordingly

blocks.zh: (d) Product ownership changes：產品授權外移或轉讓給 CDMO——需要特別的 PQS 介面管理
blocks.en: (d) Product ownership changes: product licences are transferred out or assigned to a CDMO; special PQS interface management is needed

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：APR 作為系統性改善工具
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: The APR as a Systematic Improvement Tool

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 情境下，Section 4 的 PQS 管理審查通常透過兩個機制實現：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, the Section 4 PQS management review is usually carried out through two mechanisms:

blocks.zh: Site Quality Management Review（廠區品質管理審查）：半年或每年一次，由廠長/品質長主持，審查全廠的 CAPA 完成率、偏差趨勢、稽核發現、法規 commitment 狀態、資源充足性
blocks.en: Site Quality Management Review: held every six months or annually, chaired by the site head/head of quality, reviewing the site-wide CAPA completion rate, deviation trends, audit findings, status of regulatory commitments, and adequacy of resources

blocks.zh: Quality System Metrics Dashboard（品質系統指標儀表板）：將 4.1(b) 要求的 performance indicators 視覺化，讓管理層每月都能看到 PQS 整體健康狀態
blocks.en: Quality System Metrics Dashboard: visualizes the performance indicators required by 4.1(b), so management can see the overall health of the PQS every month

blocks.zh: 對客戶而言，他們有權利要求 CDMO 提供廠區層面的 Quality System Review 結果摘要，作為 oversight（監督）的一部分——Q10 Section 2.7（委外活動管理）與此直接相關。
blocks.en: Clients have the right to ask the CDMO for a summary of the results of the site-level Quality System Review as part of their oversight. Q10 Section 2.7 (management of outsourced activities) is directly relevant here.

blocks.zh: 情境練習 Scenario-Based Practice Questions
blocks.en: Scenario-Based Practice Questions

blocks.zh: PPQMS 觸發：你是 CDMO 的品質工程師，發現過去 6 個月某一注射劑的溶液可見異物不合格率從 0.1% 緩慢上升至 0.8%（仍在規格內，但趨勢持續）。根據 Q10 PPQMS 的精神，你應該採取什麼行動？這是否需要啟動 CAPA？
blocks.en: PPQMS trigger: You are a quality engineer at a CDMO and find that over the past 6 months the visible particulate rejection rate of an injectable has slowly risen from 0.1% to 0.8% (still within specification, but the trend continues). In the spirit of the Q10 PPQMS, what action should you take? Does this require initiating a CAPA?

blocks.zh: CAPA 區分：一批口服錠劑因片重超出規格被拒絕。初步原因是加料斗感測器積粉導致讀值失準。請分別說明這個事件的 Correction、Corrective Action 和 Preventive Action 各應包含什麼內容？
blocks.en: Distinguishing CAPA: A batch of oral tablets was rejected because the tablet weight was out of specification. The preliminary cause is powder build-up on the feed hopper sensor, causing inaccurate readings. Explain what the Correction, Corrective Action and Preventive Action for this event should each include.

blocks.zh: Change Management 雙軌：你的客戶有一個已批准的 Design Space，規定混合時間 15–45 分鐘。生產部希望將混合時間從 30 分鐘縮短至 20 分鐘以提高產能。(a) 這個變更需要通知法規機關嗎？(b) 需要通過 Change Management 系統嗎？(c) 如果客戶沒有 Design Space，答案有何不同？
blocks.en: Change Management dual track: Your client has an approved Design Space that specifies a mixing time of 15-45 minutes. Production wants to shorten the mixing time from 30 minutes to 20 minutes to increase capacity. (a) Does this change need to be notified to the regulator? (b) Does it need to go through the Change Management system? (c) How would the answers differ if the client had no Design Space?

blocks.zh: Management Review 設計：你是一家中型 CDMO 的 QA Director，需要設計 Q10 合規的 Management Review 架構。請建議三層次的審查結構，並說明每層應審查哪些內容、頻率為何、以及如何確保問題能有效升級到高層管理？
blocks.en: Management Review design: You are the QA Director of a mid-sized CDMO and need to design a Q10-compliant Management Review structure. Propose a three-level review structure, and explain what each level should review, how often, and how to ensure issues are effectively escalated to senior management.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 生命週期四階段：開發 → 技術轉移 → 商業製造 → 停產；Q10 要求四大 PQS 要素在每個階段以適當且相稱的方式運作
blocks.en: Four lifecycle stages: development → technology transfer → commercial manufacturing → discontinuation; Q10 requires the four PQS elements to operate at every stage in an appropriate and proportionate manner

blocks.zh: PPQMS：以 QRM 建立控制策略，持續監測製程績效和產品品質，識別變異來源，維持管控狀態（state of control）並提供持續改善的知識基礎
blocks.en: PPQMS: establish the control strategy using QRM, continually monitor process performance and product quality, identify sources of variation, maintain the state of control, and provide the knowledge base for continual improvement

blocks.zh: CAPA：三層概念區分——Correction（修正本次事件）、Corrective Action（消除再發原因）、Preventive Action（消除潛在發生原因）；調查深度與風險等級相稱；必須驗證有效性
blocks.en: CAPA: three distinct concepts: Correction (fix this event), Corrective Action (eliminate the cause of recurrence), Preventive Action (eliminate the cause of potential occurrence); depth of investigation commensurate with risk level; effectiveness must be verified

blocks.zh: Change Management：法規雙軌——Design Space 內的變更不需法規申報，但仍需公司內部 Change Management；Design Space 外或影響核准文件的變更需依地區要求申報；實施後必須驗證目標達成
blocks.en: Change Management: dual regulatory track: changes within the Design Space need no regulatory filing but still need internal Change Management; changes outside the Design Space or affecting approved documents must be filed per regional requirements; achievement of objectives must be verified after implementation

blocks.zh: Management Review（3.2.4）：整合 PPQMS、CAPA、Change Management 結果的產品層面審查，APR/PQR 是其最直接的實務落地
blocks.en: Management Review (3.2.4): a product-level review integrating the results of the PPQMS, CAPA and Change Management; the APR/PQR is its most direct practical implementation

blocks.zh: Section 4 — PQS 持續改善：PQS 系統本身也需要被審查和改善（系統層面的 PDCA）；監控外部因素（新法規、科技進步、業務變化）確保 PQS 持續適切有效
blocks.en: Section 4: Continual Improvement of the PQS: the PQS itself must also be reviewed and improved (PDCA at the system level); monitoring external factors (new regulations, technological advances, business changes) ensures the PQS remains suitable and effective

blocks.zh: 四要素的互聯性：PPQMS → CAPA → Change Management → Management Review 形成一個完整的閉環——這個閉環，就是 Q10 相較於基本 GMP 的核心附加價值
blocks.en: Interconnection of the four elements: PPQMS → CAPA → Change Management → Management Review form a complete closed loop, and this loop is Q10's core added value over basic GMP
